# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines

- Never use em dashes in any writing or generated content. Minimize use of emojis.
- When producing documentation or markdown files, always deliver the entire document as a single contiguous copy-pasteable markdown block rather than multiple separate sections. Ignore this rule if writing the file manually in agent mode.
- Any time you are missing a permission, just ask me for it. I will grant you the necessary permissions to complete your task.
- Any time you stop without completing a task, I will ask you to continue. You should always continue until the task is complete.
- If you can't continue, explain why and what you need to continue.
- If you are unable to finish a task, immediately provide me an explanation of why and await my instructions. Do not leave tasks incomplete without explanation.
